entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. The model is an acquired seizure injury in adult male rats, not a genetic or developmental model: eight-week-old Sprague Dawley males.
entries.snippet: Experiments were conducted using 8-week-old Sprague Dawley male rats

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. The groups are small: five per sham group and eight per seizure group, with oral treatment given once a day for one week.
entries.snippet: n = 5 for each sham group. n = 8 for each seizure group.

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. In this model seizure raised the kinase PDK2 in the hippocampus and treatment with the combination lowered it, i.e. a PDK-PDH axis shift is measured after an acquired seizure injury.
entries.snippet: it was confirmed that the level of PDK2 significantly increased by 83.1% in the seizure-induced group compared to that in the sham–vehicle group.

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. Seizure lowered ATP in the model, so a seizure-induced bioenergetic deficit is measured here; it is not a measurement in a WWOX-deficient system.
entries.snippet: We found that ATP levels significantly decreased after seizure-induced group by 42.5% compared to that in the sham-vehicle group.

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. The combination raised the count of surviving hippocampal neurons versus vehicle after seizure; the effect is attributed by the authors to the combination, not to either agent.
entries.snippet: the number of NeuN (+) cells was found to be significantly higher in the DCA and pyruvate co-treatment group than in the vehicle treatment group

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. Each agent given alone was ineffective on neuronal survival in this study: the authors state that giving only DCA or only pyruvate after seizure was ineffective compared with the seizure group.
entries.snippet: the administration of only DCA or pyruvate once a day for one week after seizure was ineffective compared to the results of the seizure group

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. The behavioural endpoint is a single sensorimotor test: the adhesive removal time rose after seizure and fell with the combination by day seven.
entries.snippet: At day 7, TRT time was significantly increased by 88.5 s in the seizure-induced group compared to the sham-vehicle group.

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. The authors themselves state that the drug has neurotoxic effects at high exposure, citing earlier work, so a toxicity ceiling is acknowledged in the paper that proposes the benefit.
entries.snippet: DCA has neurotoxic effects when used at high doses
